scope: No automatic QR refresh or replay within one login generation

runs.scope: Existing Node login, MFA lifecycle and verification-view contracts
New QR stability and visible-expiry contracts
Session service contracts independently run by its owner

covered: No programmatic clicking of the official QR refresh control
Visible expiry clears image and emits metadata-only qr_expired once, then waits for a user-started new login
Expiry detection checks ancestor opacity, visibility, nonzero geometry and actual elementFromPoint occlusion
Repeated active check does not reset QR deduplication or navigate the current challenge
Same original dataPNG is relayed at most once per login generation, including an actual 6.2-second mock-main multi-tick/check run
An unrequested different official PNG clears and expires the challenge instead of silently replacing it
A new explicit login creates a fresh relay generation and may show a new original PNG
Existing raw-PNG, no-crop, MFA modal lifecycle and fresh-proof guards retained
Session service deduplicates the same PNG without count/timestamp reload and ignores late QR during MFA
boundaries: All PNG data is a synthetic tiny fixture, not a real QR code; no decoding or official-site request was performed
No SMS, model, Feishu, saved account state, user window or service was accessed
Real user reports of rotating QR remain failed historical attempts; these offline contracts do not establish a successful new official scan
Earlier auto-refresh-source reports are retained with their historical hashes and test identities; this report supersedes them only for the new single-challenge behavior
Initial PR CI remains failure on its original SHA; the Windows short-ID test fix is retained for the parent to commit with this candidate
